action.objective: Develop the knight to f3, contest the center, and prepare to castle kingside.
action.rationale: g1f3 is the only commit_ready move. Broad depth-3 search (3000 nodes) found it the top candidate (score 40), and single-candidate verification at depth 4 completed with exact score -6, PV Nf3 Bxb5 Nxb5 Nc6. Safety is complete: no immediate mate, no checking-reply refutation found. The score is slightly negative because Black equalizes comfortably, but the move is sound development that fights for d4/e5 and enables castling. No other candidate has verification, and analysis_nodes_available is 0, so I commit the verified move.
